The demineralization plant has a 
 chief role in the production of pure water suitable for boiler operation 
 avoiding many problems such as corrosion, scale formation etc.

Demi.plant include two trains A & 
 B each train consists of 3 filters or vessels, each of them contains a 
 definite type of resin material which is responsible for the 
 demineralization process i.e removing dissolved solids from water and giving 
 demineralized water depending on the ion exchange phenomenon.

Resin material is divided into two types, 
 cationic removal ( relite CF/CR) which is responsible for removing cations 
 (positive ions) from water and anionic (relite 2 AS/CR) which remove 
 negative ions from water.

The quantity of cationic resin is 700 liter put 
 in the first vessel while that of anionic resin is 750 liter and put in the 
 second vessel. The third vessel has two types of resins, cationic (relite 
 CF/MB) which remove any residual cationic ions after passing through the 
 first vessel (cation) and anionic which remove residual anionic ions after 
 passing through anionic filter (end vessel) and have the type (relite 3 
 AS/MB). The quantity of resin in third vessel which is called mixed bed is,

 has the symbol R.H. where H is the substituting functional group and R-OH is 
 the symbol of anionic resin and OH is the substituting functional group the 
 chemical reactions occurring between cationic resin, anionic resins and 
 dissolved ions, are

Cationic R H + Na CL → R Na 
 + HCL

Anionic R OH + HCL → R CL 
 + H2O

Supposing that the dissolved salt in water is 
 sodium chloride (Nacl), when passes through cation vessel cation resin 
 absorbs the positive radical of the salt (Na+) and the anion resin which 
 present in the 2nd vessel absorbs the negative radical of the 
 salt (Cl-) giving pure water or demineralized water after passing 
 certain time resin material become exhausted I.E there no ion exchange occur 
 so regeneration process is carried out for activation the resin using acid 
 and alkali.

The sulphuric acid is used for regeneration of 
 the cationic resin

R Na + H2SO4 
 → R H + NaSO4

While sodium hydroxide is used for regeneration 
 of anionic resins.
R CL + NaOH → R OH + NaCL

The plant can run under two different 
 conditions:

While fed with well water, all exchangers (cation, 
 anion and mix bed) are used. When the water to be treated comes out of 
 desalination plant (with a conductivity of 10-30 us/cm), then only mixed bed 
 can be used.

When using raw water, the operation time of 
 anion and cation exchanger between two regeneration at 7-5 m2/h 
 capacity is of 12 h and the net treated output is not less than 90m3. 
 but when desalinated water is used the operation cycle between two 
 regeneration becomes not definite, depending on the low and high salinity of 
 desalinated water. Another words, if the conductivity of desalinated water 
 is 10 us/cm the operation cycle between two regeneration is longer than that

 deminrealization plant.

Regeneration is branched into cation regeneration, anion regeneration and 
 mixed bed regeneration.

This sequence of regeneration phase will be generated after each 26

sections.text:
Backwashing of mixed bed filter differs from those of cation filter and 
 anion filter.

Backwashing of cation and anion filters remove any dirt clay and deposits 
 inside filter while that of mixed bed filter is for separating the cationic 
 resin to the lower part and anionic resin to the upper one, depending on the 
 higher specific gravity of cation resin than that of anion resin to enable 
 entering the acid and soda respectively for regeneration.
This step is for making settling of the resin before entering the acid.

In this phase, the diluted acid is injected into the mixed bed filter to 
 regenerate the cation resin in the lower part of the filter.

In this phase the diluted caustic soda will be injected into the mixed bed 
 filter to regenerate the anion resin in the upper part of the filter. At the 
 same time, the cationic resin will be washed with a stream of demineralized 
 water.

This phase is the same as soda inlet but here the closing pump will remain 
 stopped i.e. a stream of demineralized water only enter the filter to wash 
 resin and remove any regenerate residual.

The drain is necessary for the following mixing. In this step, the water of 
 the filter is partially discharged.

The air step is carried out using blower when start, the air enter the mixed 
 bed and mix the cationic and the anionic resins after their separation in 
 the backwashing step.
The resin will be settled in this step.

This step is the same as the 1st air step and carried out for 
 suring the mixing process of resins.
The filter is completed with water to the normal operational level.
